heading: 7th December 2024
body:
Transfection of pHRS-libv1 for the following:

- Gcla  
- Hcla  
- GCC  
- GCD  
- HCD  
- Nh100

Tube 1: 125 uL OM \+ 5 uL P3000 \+ 3.5 ug library

Tube 2: 125 uL OM \+ 7.5 uL P3000

Mix after 5 mins, RT.   
Incubate 15 mins, RT.

Add drop-by-drop to wells.
